title: Cincinnati
betGuide: Check, bet, call, raise or fold
fiveCardNotice: Five hole cards — a hand can be complete without touching the board
tutorial.hand: You hold five cards. Unlike Hold'em, a hand can be complete without using the board at all
tutorial.community: The board is turned one card at a time, five times, with a betting round after each
tutorial.bet: Carrying an unmade hand through five betting rounds is the most expensive thing you can do
frontendHint.cincinnatiStrongEnoughToBet: two pair or better is worth a bet
frontendHint.cincinnatiStrongEnoughToRai: trips or better can push here
frontendHint.cincinnatiWorthACall: you have a made hand, and this price is fair
frontendHint.cincinnatiCheapToStay: it is cheap enough to see one more card
frontendHint.cincinnatiNotWorthIt: no made hand, and the rounds left are not worth the price
